items.guidance: Base the image on an official Node image, copy package.json and any lockfile first, install with npm ci --omit=dev (npm install --omit=dev if no lockfile exists), then copy the source; add a build step only if package.json defines a build script. Add EXPOSE 5006 and use node index.js as the command. Deployz sets PORT at runtime, so confirm index.js reads PORT and listens on it.

Check the Express routes in index.js for an existing lightweight path before adding one. If you add one, register an app.get handler for /health that sends status 200 near the top of index.js, before static, view, or redirect middleware that could intercept it.
